scope: D15-G capability/failure matrix over D15-2..D15-5. Result is derived by scripts/d15/go_no_go/observer.py from the referenced immutable evidence; no criterion is marked PASS without committed evidence. Only atomic required capabilities can be blockers; aggregates are display-only and options are limitations.

required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: Session V3 migration PASS (9/9 fixtures); native reopen of the same persisted session id with contiguous log across a genuinely new OS process
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ conversation rehydration when native resume is unavailable (unflushed session)

required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: adapter restart rehydrated natively at the persistence seam; real isolated adapter/DSH process restart, generation replacement and executor takeover PASS with scripted keyless provider
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ lifecycle-journal rebuild plus native attach/resume; fallback only when native resume is unavailable

required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: Native fork yields a distinct seeded child with exact inherited cut (inheritedEventCount == last parent turn/end seq + 1), parent log hash+length immutable and child log contiguous
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ must not persist subagent state itself; no BYQ fallback built
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R6 Full Runtime Continuity Qualification (native seam owned by DSH)

required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: The native spawn provider runs children in-process; a child-only SIGKILL while the parent executor stays alive is not reachable. child-run-fault is supporting evidence, not a substitute.
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: none; requires an out-of-process continuable child provider
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R6 (requires an out-of-process continuable child provider)

required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: The committed byq_delegate_* composition never calls startContinuable(); a fresh adapter exposes only root resume_session and no committed BYQ surface cold-resumes a continuable child
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: none; BYQ child-session projection/rebind contract does not exist
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R6/composition hookup (Proposed ADR-0082, not accepted, not implemented)

required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: page refresh / browser disconnect / frontend restart / gateway restart rebind the SAME attachment/session/PTY in a separate client OS process with no marker replay and no loss
